about.title: Sanaria Fashion — Since 1992
about.subtitle: A Legacy of Iraqi Haute Couture and Refined Elegance
about.p1: Established in 1992, Sanaria Fashion has stood as a hallmark of luxury, distinguished style, and timeless sartorial craftsmanship in Iraq for more than three decades.
about.p2: From our beginnings, our philosophy has centered on celebrating dignity, sophistication, and meticulous tailoring. Every collection curated under the Sanaria name reflects an unwavering commitment to fine textiles, flattering cuts, and exceptional finishes.
about.p3: Today, with premier boutique locations across Baghdad (Jadriya Mall, Iraq Mall), Erbil (Majidi Mall, Family Mall), and Sulaymaniyah (Family Mall, Majidi Mall), alongside express nationwide delivery to all Iraqi governorates, Sanaria continues to dress generations with enduring distinction.
